Name: Saucy Sebastian - A Spicy Dialogue Expansion Mod
Author: mattymattloaf
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/29KqJs3.png[/img]﻿[/center][center][size=3]
Hello yet again!

People have been requesting that I make a spicy mod for Sebastian, so I pulled out my old Sexy Sebby mod, tweaked some stuff, and present it to you now! Like the other mods I've made, it adds around 400 lines of pre-marriage, marriage, gift, and festival dialogue, and the vanilla events were gone through for grammar checks and slight spice-ifying in the dialogue where I could.

[/size]The only event I didn't go through was the sixth heart event, 'cause I ain't touchin' that Solarion campaign with a ten-foot pole.[/center]
[center][color=#a4c2f4][size=2]If you're interested in potentially collaborating with me as a coder, feel free to send me a message![/size][/color][url=https://ko-fi.com/mattymattloaf]

[/url][color=#93c47d][size=2]The banner art was made by my friend, who you can commission [url=https://www.fiverr.com/dietpoison]here![/url]﻿[/size][/color][/center]
